title: GA PSC Order — Docket 44152 (Letter Order)
text:
LETTER ORDER

DOCKET NO. 44152

July 7, 2026

Israel Max
Maxsip Tel LLC
181 South Franklin Avenue Suite 304
Valley Stream, NY 11581

IN RE: Cancellation of Certificate of Authority to Provide Competitive Local
Exchange Services (CLEC).

Dear Israel Max:

At its July 7, 2026 Administrative Session, the Georgia Public Service Commission (the “Commission”) granted the Company's request to cancel certificate of authority number L-7865 and to withdraw the tariff of Maxsip Tel LLC to provide competitive local exchange services in Georgia.

The above by action of the Commission in Administrative Session on July 7, 2026.

_________________________________ _______________________________
Sallie Tanner Jaso Shaw
Executive Secretary Chairman

DATE: ___________________________ DATE: __________________________

c: Lance J.M. Steinhart. Esq.
